> Phase-level progress board for DeepSeek Harness: current phase, one-line summary, key numbers, a focused Gantt timeline and a collapsible phase list. UI auto-switches between Chinese and English (`?lang=en` / `?lang=zh`).

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供的 **goal 阶段级进度看板**。

它不记录单个工具调用，而是把一次长任务切成若干「章节（阶段）」，回答三个问题：

1. 这个 goal 现在走到第几章？
2. 每一章做了什么、产出什么、还剩什么没做？
3. 距离目标还有多远（阶段数 / 轮次 / 预估时间）？

dsh-goal-gantt README · 特性：**一屏看懂三件事**：当前在做哪一阶段（大标题 + 一句话总结）、这一阶段的四个关键数字（进度 / 已用 / 检查项 / 剩余阶段）、以及整体还剩多少。
只有「目标 + 会话 + 总进度」留在顶部，其余指标下放到阶段清单里按需展开。

dsh-goal-gantt README · 特性：- **甘特时间轴**：计划条（虚线）与实际条（实线）叠加，按时间跨度自动切换刻度（15 分钟 / 1 小时 / 6 小时 / 1 天）
- **默认聚焦现在**：打开就看当前时间窗口（以进行中阶段的时长为尺度）
- **时间轴缩放**：聚焦现在 / 6h / 24h / 全部 四档；「现在」逼近窗口边缘时自动重新取窗（不会跑出视野）
- **阶段可复用**：同一个 `id` 写多条配置会合并成一条泳道，各时间段单独画条（适合「间断优化」这类反复出现的工作）
- **Hero 当前阶段**：自动定位进行中的阶段，显示阶段名、一句话总结与四个关键数字
- **阶段清单**：每阶段一行，展开才看摘要、检查项与产出物（默认只展开进行中的那条）
- **筛选与搜索**：全部 / 进行中 / 未完成 三档切换，加一个搜索框（按 id、标题、摘要匹配），按 `/` 直接聚焦搜索
- **筛选可分享**：筛选与搜索词写进 URL（`?q=P3&f=active`），「复制链接」会把它们一起带上
- **复制摘要**：一键把当前进度复制成 Markdown（状态图标 + 阶段列表 + 剩余时间），可直接贴到 issue / IM
- **导出 CSV**：阶段表（id / 标题 / 状态 / 进度 / 计划与实际时间 / 耗时 / 检查项 / 摘要）一键下载，带 BOM 可直接用 Excel 打开
- **按状态分组**：进行中 / 未开始 / 已完成 三组，已完成默认折叠（点表头展开）
- **相对时间**：每行显示「5 小时前」/「已 2h36m」；展开状态与分组状态记在 localStorage，刷新不丢
- 版本记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)
- **距目标**：剩余阶段、轮次与预估时间，收进 Hero 底部一行
- **内嵌渲染**：作为 main 面板直接长在 DSH 里，Shadow DOM 隔离样式；也可一键新标签打开
- **不闪、不跳**：内容指纹（signature）不变时只移动时间游标，不重建 DOM；阶段状态变化才重绘
- **没有 goal 的会话**显示空态提示，不会按对话轮次编造阶段
- **加载骨架屏 / 失败重试**：首屏先出骨架，加载失败给出原因、重试按钮和独立页面入口
- **吸顶头部**：滚动时目标、进度环、会话选择器始终可见
- **点击定位**：点甘特条或阶段行，直接滚到对应阶段并高亮；支持键盘 Enter/Space
- **浅色主题**：跟随系统 `prefers-color-scheme` 自动切换，并支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`
- **键盘可达**：甘特条与阶段行都能 Tab 聚焦、Enter/Space

dsh-goal-gantt README · 没有 goal 的会话：对话即项目：没有 goal 时不再只显示空态。插件会把**对话本身**抽象成项目：

- 按**空闲间隔**切段（默认 20 分钟没动静就算新的一段），而不是硬按轮次切
- 四个数字换成时长类指标：本段用时 / 阶段数 / 总跨度 / 活跃时长（累计实际工作时间）
- 每段的标题取该段**第一条用户消息**
- 每段给出**做成了什么**：从该段最后一条助手回复里抽取一句结论（纯抽取，不调模型）；不列工具流水账
- 顶部标记「自动生成」，不伪造进度百分比，只给时长与跨度
- 全程**零 token**：只用事件类型和工具名做规则判定，不调用模型

空态只在「连事件都没有」时出现。

```jsonc
{
  "title": "GOAL 甘特看板",

**作用域**：配置默认只对「同一工作区、且当前有 goal」的会话生效，避免一个工作区里所有会话看到同一份看板。
也可以用 `sessionId` 或 `goalId` 精确绑定；没有 goal 的会话显示空态提示。

没有配置文件时自动降级：按 `goal_round` 轮次切分阶段；再没有就按对话轮次切分。

阶段进度 = `checks` 完成比例；没有 checks 时按状态估算（done=100 / active=40 / pending=0）。

**复用阶段**：同一个 `id` 可以出现多次，看板会把它们合并成一条泳道、每段画一根条，
状态取「有进行中则进行中，否则看最后一段」，耗时按各段累加。例如：

dsh-goal-gantt README · 阶段从哪来：```jsonc
{ "id": "P8", "title": "时间轴优化", "status": "done",   "startedAt": "...", "endedAt": "..." },
{ "id": "P9", "title": "文档",       "status": "done",   "startedAt": "...", "endedAt": "..." },
{ "id": "P8", "title": "时间轴优化", "status": "active", "startedAt": "..." }   // 又回来优化一次

甘特图上 P8 会是一行、两根条。

dsh-goal-gantt README · 性能：- 解析会话日志时**只解析用得上的事件**（`turn/start`、`tool/call`、消息、goal 变更），占体积最大的 `tool/result` 先行文本过滤、不进 `JSON.parse`
- 投影缓存与日志都按 `mtime + size` 缓存，重复请求只做一次解析
- 基准（`node test/perf.test.mjs`）：9.5 MB / 20k 事件的会话，冷启动约 **25 ms**，热调用 **< 1 ms**，已接入 CI
- 分组内超过 40 条时只渲染前 40 条，其余折叠为「显示更多」，避免上千阶段时 DOM 过大
- 会话列表有 3 秒 TTL 缓存，会话很多时不重复扫描目录

dsh-goal-gantt README · 数据来源：| 数据 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| goal 状态、轮次、token、轮次大纲 | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json` |
| 精确事件时间线（turn / tool / goal 变更） | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<cwd>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |

会话日志是**多帧拼接的 zstd**（每次写入一帧），Node 原生的 `zstdDecompressSync` 只解第一帧。插件按帧魔数 `28 B5 2F FD` 逐帧解压再合并 —— 这是本插件最关键的一段兼容逻辑。

dsh-goal-gantt README · 隐私：- 默认只读：不写会话、不改已有配置。**唯一的写操作**是空态里点「写入示例配置」，只会新建 `<工作区>/goal-board/board.config.json`，且文件已存在时直接拒绝（不覆盖）
- 离线：不发任何网络请求，无遥测
- 不落盘：解析结果只在内存里按 mtime 缓存 1 秒
- 路由受 DSH 的 `connection.requestRejection` 信任围栏保护（Host/Origin + 登录 cookie），绑到局域网也不会裸奔

dsh-goal-gantt README · 兼容性：- DSH Web profile，`@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.x**
- Node.js **>= 22**（依赖 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`；更低版本会退化为只读投影缓存，日志事件不可用）
- 平台：Windows / macOS / Linux（Windows 为主线开发环境）

dsh-goal-gantt README · Features：**Three things at a glance**: what you are doing now (headline + one-line summary), four numbers for that phase (progress / elapsed / checks / phases left), and how much is left overall. Only the goal, session picker and overall ring stay in the header; everything else is deferred into the phase list.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Features：- **Gantt timeline** — planned (dashed) and actual (solid) bars, tick step adapts to the span (15 min / 1 h / 6 h / 1 day)
- **Focus now by default** — opens on a window around the current time, sized from the active phase
- **Zoom presets** — Focus now / 6h / 24h / All; the view re-centres when "now" drifts past 85% of the window
- **Reusable phases** — the same `id` may appear several times; segments merge into one lane with one bar per segment
- **Current chapter** — the active phase is picked automatically, with elapsed time, tool calls, check progress and recent turns
- **Per-phase summaries** — summary, checks and deliverables, expanded on demand
- **Filter and search** — All / Active / Open plus a search box (id, title, summary); press `/` to focus it
- **Shareable filters** — the filter and query live in the URL (`?q=P3&f=active`) and are included in copied links
- **Copy summary** — copies the current progress as Markdown (status icons, phase list, time left) for issues or chat
- **Export CSV** — the phase table (id, title, status, progress, planned/actual times, duration, checks, summary) downloads as a BOM-prefixed CSV that opens in Excel

dsh-goal-gantt README · Sessions without a goal: conversation as a project：- Segments are cut by **idle gaps** (20 minutes of silence starts a new segment), not by turn count
- The four hero numbers become durations: segment time / phases / span / active time (summed working time)
- Each segment is titled by its **first user message**
- Each segment shows **what got done**: one sentence extracted from its last assistant reply (extraction only, no model call) — no tool-ledger
- The header is marked “Auto”; no fake percentages — durations and span instead
- **Zero tokens**: rules over event types and tool names, no model calls

dsh-goal-gantt README · Where phases come from：It reads `goal-board/board.config.json` from the workspace:

```jsonc
{
  "title": "Goal Gantt Board",
  "phases": [
    {

**Scope**: the config applies only to sessions in the same workspace that have a goal, so unrelated conversations do not share one board. Pin it further with `sessionId` or `goalId`; sessions without a goal show the empty state.

Without a config it falls back to `goal_round` boundaries, then to conversation turns.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Where phases come from：Phase progress = share of completed `checks`; without checks it is estimated from status (done=100 / active=40 / pending=0).

**Reusing a phase**: the same `id` may repeat; segments merge into one lane with one bar each, status is active if any segment is active, duration is summed.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Performance：- Only relevant events are parsed (`turn/start`, `tool/call`, messages, goal changes); the bulkiest `tool/result` lines are filtered out before `JSON.parse`
- Projection cache and logs are cached by `mtime + size`
- Benchmark (`node test/perf.test.mjs`): 9.5 MB / 20k events, cold ~25 ms, warm < 1 ms, wired into CI
- Groups render at most 40 rows, the rest collapse behind “show more”, so huge boards stay cheap
- The session list is cached for 3 s to avoid rescanning the directory

dsh-goal-gantt README · Data sources：| Data | Location |
|---|---|
| goal state, rounds, tokens, turn outline | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json` |
| precise event timeline (turn / tool / goal changes) | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<cwd>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |

Session logs are **multi-frame zstd** (one frame per flush); Node's `zstdDecompressSync` only decodes the first frame. The plugin walks the `28 B5 2F FD` frame magic and concatenates every frame — this is the key compatibility trick.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Privacy：- Read-only by default: never writes sessions and never touches an existing config. **The only write** is the empty-state “Create example config” button, which creates `<workspace>/goal-board/board.config.json` and refuses when the file already exists
- Offline: no network calls, no telemetry
- In-memory only: parsed results cached for a second, keyed by mtime
- Routes go through DSH's `connection.requestRejection` trust fence

dsh-goal-gantt README · Compatibility：- DSH web profile, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.x**
- Node.js **>= 22** (needs `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`; older versions degrade to projection-only)
- Windows / macOS / Linux

会话日志是**多帧拼接的 zstd**（每次写入一帧），Node 原生的 `zstdDecompressSync` 只解第一帧。插件按帧魔数 `28 B5 2F FD` 逐帧解压再合并 —— 这是本插件最关键的一段兼容逻辑。

dsh-goal-gantt README · Features：**Three things at a glance**: what you are doing now (headline + one-line summary), four numbers for that phase (progress / elapsed / checks / phases left), and how much is left overall. Only the goal, session picker and overall ring stay in the header; everything else is deferred into the phase list.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Features：- **Gantt timeline** — planned (dashed) and actual (solid) bars, tick step adapts to the span (15 min / 1 h / 6 h / 1 day)
- **Focus now by default** — opens on a window around the current time, sized from the active phase
- **Zoom presets** — Focus now / 6h / 24h / All; the view re-centres when "now" drifts past 85% of the window
- **Reusable phases** — the same `id` may appear several times; segments merge into one lane with one bar per segment
- **Current chapter** — the active phase is picked automatically, with elapsed time, tool calls, check progress and recent turns
- **Per-phase summaries** — summary, checks and deliverables, expanded on demand
- **Filter and search** — All / Active / Open plus a search box (id, title, summary); press `/` to focus it
- **Shareable filters** — the filter and query live in the URL (`?q=P3&f=active`) and are included in copied links
- **Copy summary** — copies the current progress as Markdown (status icons, phase list, time left) for issues or chat
- **Export CSV** — the phase table (id, title, status, progress, planned/actual times, duration, checks, summary) downloads as a BOM-prefixed CSV that opens in Excel

dsh-goal-gantt README · Sessions without a goal: conversation as a project：- Segments are cut by **idle gaps** (20 minutes of silence starts a new segment), not by turn count
- The four hero numbers become durations: segment time / phases / span / active time (summed working time)

- **Zero tokens**: rules over event types and tool names, no model calls

**Scope**: the config applies only to sessions in the same workspace that have a goal, so unrelated conversations do not share one board. Pin it further with `sessionId` or `goalId`; sessions without a goal show the empty state.

Without a config it falls back to `goal_round` boundaries, then to conversation turns.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Where phases come from：Phase progress = share of completed `checks`; without checks it is estimated from status (done=100 / active=40 / pending=0).

**Reusing a phase**: the same `id` may repeat; segments merge into one lane with one bar each, status is active if any segment is active, duration is summed.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Performance：- Only relevant events are parsed (`turn/start`, `tool/call`, messages, goal changes); the bulkiest `tool/result` lines are filtered out before `JSON.parse`
- Projection cache and logs are cached by `mtime + size`
- Benchmark (`node test/perf.test.mjs`): 9.5 MB / 20k events, cold ~25 ms, warm < 1 ms, wired into CI
- Groups render at most 40 rows, the rest collapse behind “show more”, so huge boards stay cheap
- The session list is cached for 3 s to avoid rescanning the directory

dsh-goal-gantt README · Data sources：| Data | Location |
|---|---|
| goal state, rounds, tokens, turn outline | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json` |
| precise event timeline (turn / tool / goal changes) | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<cwd>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` |

Session logs are **multi-frame zstd** (one frame per flush); Node's `zstdDecompressSync` only decodes the first frame. The plugin walks the `28 B5 2F FD` frame magic and concatenates every frame — this is the key compatibility trick.

dsh-goal-gantt README · Privacy：- Read-only by default: never writes sessions and never touches an existing config. **The only write** is the empty-state “Create example config” button, which creates `<workspace>/goal-board/board.config.json` and refuses when the file already exists
- Offline: no network calls, no telemetry
- In-memory only: parsed results cached for a second, keyed by mtime
- Routes go through DSH's `connection.requestRejection` trust fence
